title: Edge-Source Birth Declaration (ADR-0046 v1.0)
description: The logical contract a conformant edge source MUST assert at (N/D)BIRTH. Maps onto SparkPlug B: edge_node_id → topic <edge_node_id>; device_key → <device_id>; each metric → a SparkPlug Metric whose properties carry counter_role (+ optional source_ref). A producer validates its birth against this; edge-transformer accepts exactly this.

group_id.description: Tenant short-code. The ONLY tenant authority; MUST equal the SparkPlug group_id. MUST NOT be repeated inside metric names.

edge_node_id.description: Producing gateway id, unique per tenant (e.g. sparkplug-agent-cpack, highbyte-cpack). Aliases are unique within this scope.

device_key.description: Stable equipment key = SparkPlug <device_id>. The stack resolves it to id_equipment via packml_register (identity SSoT). Producers assert keys, never ids.

name.description: Human-readable UNS label, DISPLAY ONLY (birth-only). Never parsed for identity or semantics.

alias.description: uint64 routing key, unique within the edge_node. Carried on every later DDATA; the name is not.

datatype.description: Wire datatype of the totalizer value.

counter_role.description: REQUIRED. The closed semantic role. The ONLY place counter meaning lives. gross=infeed/consumed (oee_q denominator), net=good/processed (numerator), scrap=defective.

source_ref.description: OPTIONAL lineage only — the origin PLC index/register/tag (e.g. 'idx:168', 'DB1.DBD8'). MUST NOT be used for routing.
